ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

    s=4
    image=Image.new('L',(W*s,H*s),0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(image).polygon([(round(x*s),round(y*s)) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    return np.array(image.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),dtype=np.float32)/255

    a=orig.astype(np.float32)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H,:W].astype(np.float32)
    paper_poly=[(122.0,32.5),(125.5,31.5),(129.0,32.5),(131.7,34.5),
        (134.4,32.8),(135.8,36.0),(138.7,36.2),(140.6,38.8),(140.0,43.1),
        (141.8,47.6),(141.0,50.5),(139.8,52.5),(140.0,55.9),(138.2,59.2),
        (135.2,62.0),(131.7,64.6),(128.5,65.5),(124.3,62.5),(122.2,60.5),
        (120.5,57.4),(119.0,53.4),(118.7,48.5),(118.4,44.0),(118.8,40.5),
        (119.6,37.0),(120.8,34.5)]
    pa=poly_mask(paper_poly)
    # The two coloured jaws, their anti-aliased boundaries, and black shaft.
    reg=poly_mask([(125,0),(134,0),(134.8,12),(137,16),(143,20),(151.5,27),

       (138,29),(124,29),(119,34),(116.5,47),(116,52),(113.5,54.5),
       (110,53),(108,48),(108,32),(111,27),(118,20),(123,15),(125,12)])

    # visible neighbouring wall pixels. Grain remains completely stationary.
    dynamic=(pa>.005)|(reg>.005)
    wall=(yy<71)&(xx>96)&(xx<171)&(~cv2.dilate(dynamic.astype(np.uint8),np.ones((5,5),np.uint8)).astype(bool))

    A=np.stack(terms,-1)
    coeff=np.linalg.lstsq(A[wall],a[wall],rcond=None)[0]
    wallbg=A@coeff

    ta[(yy>42)&(xx>117)&(xx<144)]=0

    removed=np.maximum(pa,ta)
    # Dilated very slightly to take away the soft original shadows at the edges.
    erase=cv2.dilate((removed>.015).astype(np.uint8),np.ones((3,3),np.uint8)).astype(np.float32)
    erase=gaussian_filter(erase,.48)
    erase=np.maximum(erase,removed)

    indices=distance_transform_edt(pa<.9,return_distances=False,return_indices=True)
    interior=a[indices[0],indices[1]]

    water=((xx-131.5)/45.0)**2+((yy-103.5)/23.2)**2

        for prem,alpha,side in layers:

            weight=np.clip((yy-18)/11,0,1)

            cx=131.7;cy=105.5
            dx=xx-cx;dy=(yy-cy)/.49
            rr=np.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+1e-4)
            damp=np.exp(-age*1.2)

            for k in range(3):

                    wav+=env*(rr-radius)/1.75

        m=np.clip(cv2.remap(pa,mx,my,cv2.INTER_CUBIC,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT),0,1)
